name: Mintlify Index MCP server
summary: One public MCP endpoint Mintlify runs for every caller, reading across the documentation it hosts and the open web. Measured keyless on 2026-10-07, one request per probe record: initialize, tools/list, resources/list and three tool calls answered with no account and no session id. Exactly one tool, context, read-only, whose description promises primary-source citations. On three questions about a project whose documentation Mintlify generates on its own mintlify.wiki domain it never cited the project's own site; on two about one it does not, it cited the vendor's domain.
license: Hosted under Mintlify's Terms of Service

agentAccess.notes: Keyless 2026-10-07 18:06Z on https://index.mintlify.com/: initialize, tools/list and three tools/call each answered 200 with no Authorization header, no session id and no preceding initialize. The vendor: "You do not need to authenticate to the public server."

payments.notes: No keyless request drew a 402 and no page read prices this server. The pricing page's "MCP server" row is the per-site search server; "Index MCP" is absent from that page, counted by program. The documented 10/s and 5,000/day per-IP limits are a rate limit, not a paywall, and are unmeasured.

jobs.summary: The vendor's words: "read-only access to technical documentation and web context", returning "compact, source-cited context in one call". Keyless 2026-10-07: three calls answered in 1.3-2.2 s with 8,300-11,086 characters of Markdown, two sources each. Whether a citation is PRIMARY is an empty cell.
